objective: A frozen exploratory census: (1) plane ring graphs of 2 to 7 rings (simple, connected, every ring with at least two contacts): which have every closed-walk count even at every contact; (2) figure-eights and chords (two loops sharing a ring, or a loop with a chord) of rule-60 rings of equal size s = 5 to 8 with law (12,12), every order and spacing of contacts: whether every return cancels (D_cc = 1 at every contact) and whether every contact binds both rings to lag 300.
status: Supported 2026-11-08 (exploratory; H1 and H2 hold): of 395 plane ring graphs of 2 to 7 rings, 8 have every return count even, the 7 with a flip at every contact (loops, tetrahedron, octahedron) and one six-ring graph without; of 170,502 figure-eights and chords with every ring of the same size 5 to 9, none cancels every return except 20 degenerate ones, and 500 persist to lag 300 through other cells (none of the figure-eights of two three-ring loops or the theta 2,2,2).
title: A census of networks of loops
